highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and aligns HarfBuzz binding generation with bundled native sources.
highlights_body: The HarfBuzz managed surface follows the pinned native revision while correcting a combining-class name and removing aggregate flag masks.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed
breaking.body: The misspelled `CCC133` member is now `CCC132`, matching the upstream HarfBuzz name while retaining numeric value 132. Replace references to the old member before upgrading.

breaking.title: Aggregate HarfBuzz flag masks are unavailable
breaking.body: `GlyphFlags.Defined` is removed, and equivalent aggregate `Defined` masks are not exposed for buffer flags. Combine the concrete flags your code requires instead.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to the Skia m154 release line.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz bindings follow bundled native sources
bullets.detail: Binding generation now derives from the HarfBuzz revision pinned in Skia DEPS, keeping supported types and enum values synchronized with the library shipped in the package.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update and the aligned HarfBuzz binding-generation model.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It also aligns HarfBuzz binding generation with the native source bundled in the package.
